code:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="bn">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>APK Studio Pro — Web to App Packager</title>

    <!-- Fonts & Icons -->
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.4.0/css/all.min.css">
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Hind+Siliguri:wght@400;500;600;700&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500;700&family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

    <!-- ZIP & File Saver Libraries -->
    <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/jszip/3.10.1/jszip.min.js"></script>
    <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/FileSaver.js/2.0.5/FileSaver.min.js"></script>

    <style>
        :root {
            --bg-app: #0b0f17;
            --bg-surface: #111827;
            --bg-elevated: #172033;
            --bg-editor: #0d131f;
            --border-subtle: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.14);
            --border-focus: rgba(0, 230, 118, 0.65);

            --primary: #00e676;
            --primary-hover: #1aff8c;
            --primary-dark: #00b248;
            --primary-soft: rgba(0, 230, 118, 0.12);

            --accent: #38bdf8;
            --danger: #f43f5e;
            --warning: #f59e0b;

            --text-main: #f1f5f9;
            --text-muted: #94a3b8;
            --text-dim: #64748b;

            --radius-sm: 8px;
            --radius-md: 12px;
            --radius-lg: 18px;
            --shadow-lg: 0 20px 50px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55);
        }

        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        body {
            background: radial-gradient(circle at top right, rgba(0, 230, 118, 0.06), transparent 40%),
                        radial-gradient(circle at bottom left, rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.05), transparent 40%),
                        var(--bg-app);
            color: var(--text-main);
            font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', 'Hind Siliguri', sans-serif;
            height: 100dvh;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        /* Custom Scrollbar */
        ::-webkit-scrollbar {
            width: 7px;
            height: 7px;
        }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
            background: transparent;
        }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
            background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.22);
            border-radius: 999px;
        }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
            background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.38);
        }

        /* --- Header --- */
        header {
            height: 62px;
            padding: 0 20px;
            background: rgba(17, 24, 39, 0.85);
            backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            gap: 12px;
            z-index: 20;
        }

        .brand {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 12px;
        }

        .brand-badge {
            width: 38px;
            height: 38px;
            border-radius: 10px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(0, 230, 118, 0.18), rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.12));
            border: 1px solid rgba(0, 230, 118, 0.35);
            display: grid;
            place-items: center;
            color: var(--primary);
            font-size: 1.2rem;
        }

        .brand-text h1 {
            font-size: 1.05rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            letter-spacing: -0.01em;
            line-height: 1.2;
        }

        .brand-text span {
            font-size: 0.72rem;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            display: block;
        }

        .toolbar {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 10px;
        }

        .btn {
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            background: var(--bg-elevated);
            color: var(--text-main);
            padding: 8px 14px;
            border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
            font-size: 0.86rem;
            font-weight: 500;
            font-family: inherit;
            cursor: pointer;
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
            transition: all 0.2s ease;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .btn:hover {
            background: #222f49;
            border-color: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.35);
            transform: translateY(-1px);
        }

        .btn-ghost-icon {
            padding: 7px 10px;
            font-size: 0.82rem;
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }

        .btn-primary {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary), var(--primary-dark));
            color: #05110a;
            border: none;
            font-weight: 700;
            box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(0, 230, 118, 0.22);
        }

        .btn-primary:hover {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary-hover), var(--primary));
            box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 230, 118, 0.34);
        }

        /* --- Main Editor Workspace --- */
        .workspace {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            min-height: 0;
            padding: 14px 16px 10px;
            gap: 10px;
        }

        .editor-card {
            flex: 1;
            min-height: 0;
            background: var(--bg-editor);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            border-radius: var(--radius-md);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            overflow: hidden;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
        }

        .editor-topbar {
            height: 40px;
            padding: 0 14px;
            background: var(--bg-surface);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            font-size: 0.8rem;
        }

        .file-pill {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 7px;
            background: var(--bg-elevated);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            padding: 4px 10px;
            border-radius: 6px;
            color: var(--accent);
            font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 0.78rem;
        }

        .editor-actions {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 6px;
        }

        .editor-body {
            flex: 1;
            min-height: 0;
            display: flex;
            position: relative;
        }

        .line-numbers {
            width: 54px;
            padding: 16px 10px 16px 0;
            background: rgba(11, 15, 23, 0.65);
            color: var(--text-dim);
            font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 13.5px;
            line-height: 1.6;
            text-align: right;
            user-select: none;
            overflow: hidden;
            border-right: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            white-space: pre;
        }

        textarea#htmlCode {
            flex: 1;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            padding: 16px 18px;
            background: transparent;
            color: #e2e8f0;
            border: none;
            outline: none;
            resize: none;
            font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 13.5px;
            line-height: 1.6;
            tab-size: 2;
        }

        /* Status Bar */
        .statusbar {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            padding: 0 6px;
            font-size: 0.76rem;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 8px;
        }

        .status-group {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 14px;
        }

        .status-dot {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 6px;
            color: var(--primary);
        }

        .status-dot::before {
            content: "";
            width: 7px;
            height: 7px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--primary);
            box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--primary);
        }

        /* --- Preview Modal --- */
        .modal-backdrop {
            position: fixed;
            inset: 0;
            background: rgba(2, 6, 23, 0.78);
            backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
            display: none;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            padding: 18px;
            z-index: 100;
        }

        .modal-backdrop.active {
            display: flex;
            animation: fadeIn 0.18s ease-out;
        }

        @keyframes fadeIn {
            from { opacity: 0; }
            to { opacity: 1; }
        }

        #preview-modal.active {
            background: rgba(2, 6, 23, 0.92);
        }

        .preview-shell {
            width: 100%;
            max-width: 1100px;
            height: 92dvh;
            background: var(--bg-surface);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            overflow: hidden;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
        }

        .preview-header {
            height: 54px;
            padding: 0 16px;
            background: var(--bg-elevated);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            gap: 10px;
        }

        .viewport-switch {
            display: inline-flex;
            background: var(--bg-app);
            padding: 3px;
            border-radius: 8px;
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
        }

        .vp-btn {
            background: transparent;
            border: none;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            padding: 5px 11px;
            border-radius: 6px;
            font-size: 0.78rem;
            cursor: pointer;
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 6px;
            transition: 0.15s;
        }

        .vp-btn.active {
            background: var(--primary-soft);
            color: var(--primary);
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .preview-stage {
            flex: 1;
            background: #090d16;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            padding: 18px;
            overflow: auto;
        }

        iframe#previewFrame {
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            border: none;
            background: #ffffff;
            border-radius: 8px;
            transition: width 0.25s ease, height 0.25s ease, border-radius 0.25s ease;
        }

        iframe#previewFrame.mobile-frame {
            width: 390px;
            height: 760px;
            max-height: 100%;
            border-radius: 28px;
            border: 6px solid #1e293b;
            box-shadow: 0 24px 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7);
        }

        /* --- APK Config Modal --- */
        .config-modal {
            width: 100%;
            max-width: 620px;
            max-height: 92dvh;
            background: var(--bg-surface);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            overflow: hidden;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
        }

        .modal-header {
            padding: 18px 22px;
            background: var(--bg-elevated);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
        }

        .modal-header h2 {
            font-size: 1.12rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-main);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 10px;
        }

        .modal-header h2 i {
            color: var(--primary);
        }

        .close-x {
            width: 32px;
            height: 32px;
            border-radius: 8px;
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            background: transparent;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            cursor: pointer;
            display: grid;
            place-items: center;
            transition: 0.15s;
        }

        .close-x:hover {
            background: rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.14);
            color: #fda4af;
            border-color: rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.4);
        }

        .modal-body {
            padding: 22px;
            overflow-y: auto;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 18px;
        }

        .grid-2 {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: 14px;
        }

        .grid-3 {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr;
            gap: 12px;
        }

        .form-group label {
            display: block;
            font-size: 0.82rem;
            font-weight: 500;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            margin-bottom: 6px;
        }

        .form-control {
            width: 100%;
            padding: 10px 12px;
            background: var(--bg-app);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
            color: var(--text-main);
            font-family: inherit;
            font-size: 0.9rem;
            transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
        }

        .form-control:focus {
            outline: none;
            border-color: var(--border-focus);
            box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0, 230, 118, 0.12);
        }

        .form-hint {
            font-size: 0.72rem;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            margin-top: 4px;
        }

        .form-error {
            font-size: 0.75rem;
            color: #fb7185;
            margin-top: 5px;
            display: none;
        }

        /* Icon Uploader */
        .upload-box {
            border: 1.5px dashed rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.28);
            background: rgba(11, 15, 23, 0.55);
            border-radius: var(--radius-md);
            padding: 16px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            gap: 14px;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: 0.2s;
        }

        .upload-box:hover {
            border-color: var(--primary);
            background: var(--primary-soft);
        }

        .upload-info {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 12px;
        }

        .upload-icon-circle {
            width: 42px;
            height: 42px;
            border-radius: 10px;
            background: var(--bg-elevated);
            display: grid;
            place-items: center;
            color: var(--primary);
            font-size: 1.1rem;
        }

        .upload-title {
            font-size: 0.88rem;
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .upload-sub {
            font-size: 0.74rem;
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }

        .icon-thumb {
            width: 48px;
            height: 48px;
            border-radius: 11px;
            object-fit: cover;
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            display: none;
            background: #fff;
        }

        /* Section Box */
        .panel-box {
            background: rgba(11, 15, 23, 0.5);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            border-radius: var(--radius-md);
            padding: 14px 16px;
        }

        .panel-label {
            font-size: 0.78rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.05em;
            color: var(--primary);
            margin-bottom: 10px;
            display: block;
        }

        .toggle-row {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            padding: 10px 0;
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.09);
            gap: 12px;
        }

        .toggle-row:last-child {
            border-bottom: none;
            padding-bottom: 2px;
        }

        .toggle-text strong {
            display: block;
            font-size: 0.88rem;
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .toggle-text span {
            font-size: 0.75rem;
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }

        .switch {
            position: relative;
            display: inline-block;
            width: 44px;
            height: 24px;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .switch input {
            opacity: 0;
            width: 0;
            height: 0;
        }

        .slider {
            position: absolute;
            cursor: pointer;
            inset: 0;
            background-color: #334155;
            transition: 0.25s;
            border-radius: 999px;
        }

        .slider:before {
            position: absolute;
            content: "";
            height: 18px;
            width: 18px;
            left: 3px;
            bottom: 3px;
            background-color: #fff;
            transition: 0.25s;
            border-radius: 50%;
        }

        input:checked + .slider {
            background-color: var(--primary);
        }

        input:checked + .slider:before {
            transform: translateX(20px);
        }

        input:disabled + .slider {
            opacity: 0.65;
            cursor: not-allowed;
        }

        .info-callout {
            background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.08);
            border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.25);
            border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
            padding: 11px 13px;
            font-size: 0.78rem;
            color: #bae6fd;
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        .modal-footer {
            padding: 15px 22px;
            background: var(--bg-elevated);
            border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            display: flex;
            justify-content: flex-end;
            gap: 10px;
        }

        /* --- Build Progress Modal --- */
        #loader-modal {
            z-index: 200;
        }

        .loader-card {
            width: 100%;
            max-width: 440px;
            background: var(--bg-surface);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
            padding: 26px;
            text-align: center;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
        }

        .spinner-ring {
            width: 54px;
            height: 54px;
            margin: 0 auto 16px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            border: 4px solid rgba(0, 230, 118, 0.16);
            border-top-color: var(--primary);
            animation: spin 0.85s linear infinite;
        }

        @keyframes spin {
            to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
        }

        .loader-card h3 {
            font-size: 1.08rem;
            margin-bottom: 6px;
        }

        .loader-card p {
            font-size: 0.84rem;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            margin-bottom: 16px;
        }

        .progress-track {
            width: 100%;
            height: 8px;
            background: var(--bg-app);
            border-radius: 999px;
            overflow: hidden;
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
        }

        .progress-fill {
            width: 0%;
            height: 100%;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--primary-dark), var(--primary));
            transition: width 0.25s ease;
        }

        /* Toast Notification */
        .toast {
            position: fixed;
            bottom: 22px;
            right: 22px;
            background: var(--bg-elevated);
            color: var(--text-main);
            border: 1px solid rgba(0, 230, 118, 0.4);
            padding: 11px 16px;
            border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
            font-size: 0.84rem;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
            display: none;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 9px;
            z-index: 300;
        }

        .toast.show {
            display: flex;
            animation: fadeIn 0.2s ease;
        }

        @media (max-width: 640px) {
            .brand-text span { display: none; }
            .btn span.btn-label { display: none; }
            .grid-2, .grid-3 { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>

    <!-- Top Header -->
    <header>
        <div class="brand">
            <div class="brand-badge">
                <i class="fab fa-android"></i>
            </div>
            <div class="brand-text">
                <h1>APK Studio Pro</h1>
                <span>HTML/CSS/JS to App Project Packager</span>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="toolbar">
            <button type="button" class="btn" onclick="openPreview()">
                <i class="fas fa-play"></i>
                <span class="btn-label">অ্যাপ রিভিউ</span>
            </button>
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" onclick="openConfig()">
                <i class="fas fa-box-open"></i>
                <span class="btn-label">প্যাকেজ বিল্ড</span>
            </button>
        </div>
    </header>

    <!-- Editor Workspace -->
    <main class="workspace">
        <section class="editor-card">
            <div class="editor-topbar">
                <div class="file-pill">
                    <i class="fab fa-html5"></i> index.html
                </div>
                <div class="editor-actions">
                    <button type="button" class="btn btn-ghost-icon" onclick="copyCode()" title="কোড কপি করুন">
                        <i class="far fa-copy"></i> কপি
                    </button>
                    <button type="button" class="btn btn-ghost-icon" onclick="resetCode()" title="ডিফল্ট টেমপ্লেট লোড করুন">
                        <i class="fas fa-rotate-left"></i> রিসেট
                    </button>
                </div>
            </div>

            <div class="editor-body">
                <div id="lineNumbers" class="line-numbers">1</div>
                <textarea id="htmlCode" spellcheck="false" placeholder="আপনার HTML কোড এখানে লিখুন..."></textarea>
            </div>
        </section>

        <div class="statusbar">
            <div class="status-group">
                <span class="status-dot">Ready to Build</span>
                <span id="cursorPos">Line 1, Col 1</span>
            </div>
            <div class="status-group">
                <span id="charCount">0 chars</span>
                <span>UTF-8</span>
            </div>
        </div>
    </main>

    <!-- Live Preview Modal -->
    <div id="preview-modal" class="modal-backdrop">
        <div class="preview-shell">
            <div class="preview-header">
                <div class="viewport-switch">
                    <button type="button" id="vpMobile" class="vp-btn active" onclick="setViewport('mobile')">
                        <i class="fas fa-mobile-screen"></i> Mobile
                    </button>
                    <button type="button" id="vpDesktop" class="vp-btn" onclick="setViewport('desktop')">
                        <i class="fas fa-desktop"></i> Full
                    </button>
                </div>

                <button type="button" class="close-x" onclick="closePreview()" title="বন্ধ করুন">
                    <i class="fas fa-times"></i>
                </button>
            </div>
            <div class="preview-stage">
                <iframe id="previewFrame" class="mobile-frame" sandbox="allow-scripts allow-modals allow-forms"></iframe>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- APK Configuration Modal -->
    <div id="config-modal" class="modal-backdrop">
        <div class="config-modal">
            <div class="modal-header">
                <h2><i class="fas fa-sliders"></i> অ্যাপ কনফিগারেশন</h2>
                <button type="button" class="close-x" onclick="closeConfig()" title="বন্ধ করুন">
                    <i class="fas fa-times"></i>
                </button>
            </div>

            <div class="modal-body">
                <div class="grid-2">
                    <div class="form-group">
                        <label for="appName">অ্যাপের নাম (App Name)</label>
                        <input type="text" id="appName" class="form-control" value="MyApp" maxlength="40">
                    </div>

                    <div class="form-group">
                        <label for="pkgName">প্যাকেজ নেম (Package ID)</label>
                        <input type="text" id="pkgName" class="form-control" value="com.user.myapp" placeholder="com.company.app">
                        <div id="pkgError" class="form-error">সঠিক ফরম্যাট দিন (যেমন: com.user.myapp)</div>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="grid-3">
                    <div class="form-group">
                        <label for="appVersion">ভার্সন নেম</label>
                        <input type="text" id="appVersion" class="form-control" value="1.0.0">
                    </div>
                    <div class="form-group">
                        <label for="versionCode">ভার্সন কোড</label>
                        <input type="number" id="versionCode" class="form-control" value="1" min="1">
                    </div>
                    <div class="form-group">
                        <label for="themeColor">থিম কালার</label>
                        <input type="color" id="themeColor" class="form-control" value="#00e676" style="height: 40px; padding: 4px;">
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="form-group">
                    <label>অ্যাপ আইকন (প্রস্তাবিত: 512×512 PNG)</label>
                    <div class="upload-box" onclick="document.getElementById('iconFile').click()">
                        <div class="upload-info">
                            <div class="upload-icon-circle">
                                <i class="fas fa-image"></i>
                            </div>
                            <div>
                                <div class="upload-title" id="iconFileName">আইকন ফাইল নির্বাচন করুন</div>
                                <div class="upload-sub">PNG, JPG বা WEBP — জিপে icon.png হিসেবে যুক্ত হবে</div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <img id="iconPreview" class="icon-thumb" alt="Icon Preview">
                        <input type="file" id="iconFile" hidden accept="image/*" onchange="handleImage(this)">
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="panel-box">
                    <span class="panel-label">ফিচারস ও পারমিশন</span>

                    <div class="toggle-row">
                        <div class="toggle-text">
                            <strong>ফাইল / মিডিয়া ডাউনলোড হেল্পার</strong>
                            <span>HTML কোডে অটো-ডাউনলোড হেল্পার স্ক্রিপ্ট যুক্ত করবে</span>
                        </div>
                        <label class="switch">
                            <input type="checkbox" id="featDl" checked>
                            <span class="slider"></span>
                        </label>
                    </div>

                    <div class="toggle-row">
                        <div class="toggle-text">
                            <strong>ক্যামেরা পারমিশন (CAMERA)</strong>
                            <span>কনফিগ ও ম্যানিফেস্ট টেমপ্লেটে ক্যামেরা অনুমতি যোগ করবে</span>
                        </div>
                        <label class="switch">
                            <input type="checkbox" id="featCam">
                            <span class="slider"></span>
                        </label>
                    </div>

                    <div class="toggle-row">
                        <div class="toggle-text">
                            <strong>ইন্টারনেট পারমিশন (INTERNET)</strong>
                            <span>WebView / ওয়েব রিসোর্সের জন্য ডিফল্টভাবে সক্রিয়</span>
                        </div>
                        <label class="switch">
                            <input type="checkbox" id="featNet" checked disabled>
                            <span class="slider"></span>
                        </label>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="info-callout">
                    <i class="fas fa-circle-info"></i>
                    ব্রাউজার থেকে সরাসরি <strong>.apk</strong> ফাইল বিল্ড হয় না; এই টুলটি আপনার কোড, কনফিগ (`app_config.json`, `manifest.json`) ও আইকন গুছিয়ে একটি <strong>Project ZIP</strong> তৈরি করে, যা দিয়ে Capacitor, Cordova, WebView বা Android Studio-তে সহজেই ফাইনাল APK বানানো যায়।
                </div>
            </div>

            <div class="modal-footer">
                <button type="button" class="btn" onclick="closeConfig()">বাতিল</button>
                <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" onclick="startBuild()">
                    <i class="fas fa-gears"></i> প্যাকেজ তৈরি করুন
                </button>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Build Progress Modal -->
    <div id="loader-modal" class="modal-backdrop">
        <div class="loader-card">
            <div class="spinner-ring"></div>
            <h3>প্রজেক্ট প্যাকেজ তৈরি হচ্ছে</h3>
            <p id="loaderStatus">HTML ও কনফিগ ফাইল প্রস্তুত করা হচ্ছে...</p>
            <div class="progress-track">
                <div id="progressBar" class="progress-fill"></div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Toast -->
    <div id="toast" class="toast">
        <i class="fas fa-check-circle" style="color: var(--primary);"></i>
        <span id="toastMsg">সম্পন্ন হয়েছে</span>
    </div>

    <script>
        const defaultCode = `<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="bn">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>My Mobile App</title>
    <style>
        * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
        body {
            min-height: 100vh;
            background: linear-gradient(160deg, #0f172a, #1e293b);
            color: #f8fafc;
            font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            padding: 24px;
            text-align: center;
        }
        .card {
            max-width: 380px;
            width: 100%;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
            border-radius: 20px;
            padding: 28px 22px;
            backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
        }
        img {
            width: 84px;
            height: 84px;
            margin-bottom: 16px;
        }
        h1 { font-size: 1.5rem; margin-bottom: 8px; }
        p { color: #cbd5e1; font-size: 0.95rem; line-height: 1.5; }
        button {
            margin-top: 22px;
            width: 100%;
            background: #00e676;
            color: #062112;
            border: none;
            padding: 13px 20px;
            border-radius: 999px;
            font-size: 1rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            cursor: pointer;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <div class="card">
        <img src="https://cdn-icons-png.flaticon.com/512/732/732205.png" alt="App Logo">
        <h1>স্বাগতম!</h1>
        <p>এটি আপনার মোবাইল অ্যাপের মূল ইন্টারফেস। এডিটরে নিজের মতো করে ডিজাইন বদলে নিন।</p>
        <button type="button" onclick="testAction()">টেস্ট অ্যাকশন</button>
    </div>

    <script>
        function testAction() {
            alert('অ্যাপ প্রিভিউ ও স্ক্রিপ্ট সঠিকভাবে কাজ করছে!');
        }
    <\/script>
</body>
</html>`;

        const textarea = document.getElementById('htmlCode');
        const lineNumbers = document.getElementById('lineNumbers');
        const cursorPos = document.getElementById('cursorPos');
        const charCount = document.getElementById('charCount');

        textarea.value = defaultCode;

        function updateEditorMeta() {
            const val = textarea.value;
            const totalLines = val.split('\n').length;

            let linesArr = [];
            for (let i = 1; i <= totalLines; i++) {
                linesArr.push(i);
            }
            lineNumbers.textContent = linesArr.join('\n');

            const selStart = textarea.selectionStart || 0;
            const upToCursor = val.slice(0, selStart).split('\n');
            const currentLine = upToCursor.length;
            const currentCol = upToCursor[upToCursor.length - 1].length + 1;

            cursorPos.textContent = `Line ${currentLine}, Col ${currentCol}`;
            charCount.textContent = `${val.length.toLocaleString()} chars`;
        }

        textarea.addEventListener('input', updateEditorMeta);
        textarea.addEventListener('click', updateEditorMeta);
        textarea.addEventListener('keyup', updateEditorMeta);
        textarea.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
            lineNumbers.scrollTop = textarea.scrollTop;
        });

        // Tab key indentation support
        textarea.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                e.preventDefault();
                const start = textarea.selectionStart;
                const end = textarea.selectionEnd;
                const indent = '    ';
                textarea.value = textarea.value.substring(0, start) + indent + textarea.value.substring(end);
                textarea.selectionStart = textarea.selectionEnd = start + indent.length;
                updateEditorMeta();
            }
        });

        updateEditorMeta();

        function showToast(message) {
            const toast = document.getElementById('toast');
            document.getElementById('toastMsg').textContent = message;
            toast.classList.add('show');
            clearTimeout(window._toastTimer);
            window._toastTimer = setTimeout(() => {
                toast.classList.remove('show');
            }, 2600);
        }

        function copyCode() {
            navigator.clipboard.writeText(textarea.value).then(() => {
                showToast('কোড ক্লিপবোর্ডে কপি করা হয়েছে');
            }).catch(() => {
                textarea.select();
                document.execCommand('copy');
                showToast('কোড কপি করা হয়েছে');
            });
        }

        function resetCode() {
            if (confirm('বর্তমান কোড মুছে ডিফল্ট টেমপ্লেট লোড করতে চান?')) {
                textarea.value = defaultCode;
                updateEditorMeta();
                showToast('ডিফল্ট টেমপ্লেট লোড করা হয়েছে');
            }
        }

        // Preview Modal Controls
        function openPreview() {
            const frame = document.getElementById('previewFrame');
            frame.srcdoc = textarea.value;
            document.getElementById('preview-modal').classList.add('active');
        }

        function closePreview() {
            document.getElementById('preview-modal').classList.remove('active');
        }

        function setViewport(mode) {
            const frame = document.getElementById('previewFrame');
            const btnMobile = document.getElementById('vpMobile');
            const btnDesktop = document.getElementById('vpDesktop');

            if (mode === 'mobile') {
                frame.classList.add('mobile-frame');
                btnMobile.classList.add('active');
                btnDesktop.classList.remove('active');
            } else {
                frame.classList.remove('mobile-frame');
                btnDesktop.classList.add('active');
                btnMobile.classList.remove('active');
            }
        }

        // Config Modal Controls
        function openConfig() {
            document.getElementById('pkgError').style.display = 'none';
            document.getElementById('config-modal').classList.add('active');
        }

        function closeConfig() {
            document.getElementById('config-modal').classList.remove('active');
        }

        function handleImage(input) {
            const preview = document.getElementById('iconPreview');
            const label = document.getElementById('iconFileName');
            if (input.files && input.files[0]) {
                const file = input.files[0];
                label.textContent = file.name;
                const reader = new FileReader();
                reader.onload = (e) => {
                    preview.src = e.target.result;
                    preview.style.display = 'block';
                };
                reader.readAsDataURL(file);
            }
        }

        function sanitizeFileName(name) {
            return (name || 'MyApp').trim().replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, '_') || 'MyApp';
        }

        function isValidPackageName(pkg) {
            return /^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*(\.[a-z][a-z0-9_]*)+$/.test(pkg.trim());
        }

        // Build Sequence
        function startBuild() {
            const rawAppName = document.getElementById('appName').value.trim() || 'MyApp';
            const pkgName = document.getElementById('pkgName').value.trim();
            const pkgError = document.getElementById('pkgError');

            if (!isValidPackageName(pkgName)) {
                pkgError.style.display = 'block';
                document.getElementById('pkgName').focus();
                return;
            }
            pkgError.style.display = 'none';

            closeConfig();

            const loaderModal = document.getElementById('loader-modal');
            const statusEl = document.getElementById('loaderStatus');
            const progressEl = document.getElementById('progressBar');

            loaderModal.classList.add('active');
            progressEl.style.width = '10%';

            const steps = [
                { pct: 28, text: 'HTML/CSS/JS সোর্স যাচাই করা হচ্ছে...' },
                { pct: 52, text: 'অ্যাপ কনফিগারেশন ও ম্যানিফেস্ট তৈরি হচ্ছে...' },
                { pct: 76, text: 'আইকন ও রিসোর্স প্যাক করা হচ্ছে...' },
                { pct: 95, text: 'ফাইনাল ZIP প্যাকেজ কম্প্রেস করা হচ্ছে...' }
            ];

            let idx = 0;
            const stepTimer = setInterval(() => {
                if (idx < steps.length) {
                    progressEl.style.width = steps[idx].pct + '%';
                    statusEl.textContent = steps[idx].text;
                    idx++;
                } else {
                    clearInterval(stepTimer);
                    generatePackage(rawAppName, pkgName);
                }
            }, 550);
        }

        function generatePackage(appName, pkgName) {
            const zip = new JSZip();
            const safeName = sanitizeFileName(appName);
            const versionName = document.getElementById('appVersion').value.trim() || '1.0.0';
            const versionCode = parseInt(document.getElementById('versionCode').value, 10) || 1;
            const themeColor = document.getElementById('themeColor').value || '#00e676';
            const featDl = document.getElementById('featDl').checked;
            const featCam = document.getElementById('featCam').checked;

            let htmlContent = textarea.value;

            if (featDl) {
                const helperScript = `\n<script>\nfunction triggerAppDownload(url, filename = '') {\n    const link = document.createElement('a');\n    link.href = url;\n    link.download = filename;\n    document.body.appendChild(link);\n    link.click();\n    document.body.removeChild(link);\n}\n<\/script>\n`;
                if (/<\/body>/i.test(htmlContent)) {
                    htmlContent = htmlContent.replace(/<\/body>/i, helperScript + '</body>');
                } else {
                    htmlContent += helperScript;
                }
            }

            const configObj = {
                appName,
                packageName: pkgName,
                versionName,
                versionCode,
                themeColor,
                permissions: {
                    internet: true,
                    camera: featCam,
                    downloadHelper: featDl
                },
                generatedAt: new Date().toISOString()
            };

            const webManifest = {
                name: appName,
                short_name: appName.slice(0, 12),
                start_url: "./index.html",
                display: "standalone",
                background_color: "#0b0f17",
                theme_color: themeColor,
                icons: [
                    {
                        src: "icon.png",
                        sizes: "512x512",
                        type: "image/png"
                    }
                ]
            };

            const guideText = `# ${appName} — App Build Guide

Package Name: ${pkgName}
Version: ${versionName} (${versionCode})

## ভেতরের ফাইলসমূহ
- index.html : আপনার মূল ওয়েব/অ্যাপ ইন্টারফেস কোড
- app_config.json : অ্যাপের মেটাডাটা ও পারমিশন সেটিংস
- manifest.json : PWA / Web App ম্যানিফেস্ট টেমপ্লেট
- icon.png : আপনার আপলোড করা অ্যাপ আইকন (যদি সিলেক্ট করে থাকেন)

## APK তৈরির উপায়
ব্রাউজার থেকে সরাসরি Android Signing Key ছাড়া .apk তৈরি হয় না। এই ফোল্ডারটি নিয়ে:
1. Capacitor / Cordova প্রজেক্টের \`www/\` ফোল্ডারে \`index.html\` ও \`icon.png\` রাখুন এবং \`app_config.json\` অনুযায়ী Package ID সেট করুন।
2. অথবা Android Studio / WebView wrapper প্রজেক্টে \`assets/index.html\` হিসেবে যুক্ত করে Build APK করুন।
`;

            zip.file('index.html', htmlContent);
            zip.file('app_config.json', JSON.stringify(configObj, null, 2));
            zip.file('manifest.json', JSON.stringify(webManifest, null, 2));
            zip.file('BUILD_GUIDE.md', guideText);

            const iconInput = document.getElementById('iconFile');
            if (iconInput.files && iconInput.files[0]) {
                zip.file('icon.png', iconInput.files[0]);
            }

            zip.generateAsync({ type: 'blob' }).then((blob) => {
                document.getElementById('progressBar').style.width = '100%';
                setTimeout(() => {
                    document.getElementById('loader-modal').classList.remove('active');
                    saveAs(blob, `${safeName}_v${versionName}_Project.zip`);
                    showToast(`${safeName} প্যাকেজ ডাউনলোড শুরু হয়েছে`);
                }, 250);
            }).catch((err) => {
                document.getElementById('loader-modal').classList.remove('active');
                alert('প্যাকেজ তৈরি করতে সমস্যা হয়েছে: ' + err.message);
            });
        }

        // Escape key closes modals
        document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                closePreview();
                closeConfig();
            }
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>
